title: Markdown table renderer with alignment and pipe escaping
requirements: render(headers, rows) returns a GitHub markdown table: header row, separator row, one row per data row, each cell padded to its column width (minimum 3)
align='lrc...' gives ':---', '---:', ':-:' separators (and left/right/centre padding); default is plain '---' and left padding
'|' inside a cell is escaped as '\|', and the escaped text is what counts toward the column width
user_messages: mdtable.render(headers, rows) → a github markdown table string. pad every cell to the column width, min width 3
optional align string, one letter per column: l, r, c → :---, ---:, :-: in the separator row. default is plain ---
cells can contain | (shell commands in our docs) so escape them as \| — and the escaped version is what counts for width
